content: ECS vs inheritance for sims: composition over inheritance, separation of data and behaviour, easy serialization and entity creation, contiguous component storage for many entities. RimWorld uses a Def (static data) vs Thing (instance) split with ThingComp/HediffComp as an informal comp pattern; Hediffs (health diffs) attach to specific body parts with severity stages. This is data-driven composition, not a deep class tree. Photon Quantum: pure C# deterministic ECS simulation fully decoupled from Unity view, entity views bound to simulation entities. Confirmed across multiple sources.
